Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise playbook and the artifacts we can produce. I attached a sample evidence package (bluepraxis_sig_answers_v2.pdf) and a segmented erase checklist to show the deliverables.

1) Tenant data erase (customer-initiated) — high level
- Request intake: customer opens a deletion request via Console or signed email (we log a request id).
- Authorization: cross-check requestor identity and account owners (we require admin confirmation).
- Scope & confirmation: define scope (conversational transcripts, fine-tuning artifacts, ephemeral traces).
- Execution: schedule erase window, mark affected shards, run controlled erase job with immutable audit logging.
- Verification: return a proof package with timestamps, purge manifests, and deletion hashes.
- Retention of evidence: Redwood retains the proof package for 90 days by default (longer by request).

Typical timelines: small tenant (<100GB) — erase + verification in 24–72 hours; larger tenants may need coordinated windows.

2) Temporary log hold (forensics)
- BluePraxis may request a temporary log hold via the Console or signed legal request.
- Hold duration: standard temporary hold up to 14 calendar days (we can extend by mutual agreement).
- Implementation: we snapshot relevant telemetry/traffic/debug traces to an immutable store and mark the tenant as frozen for deletion workflows.
- Evidence: chain-of-custody note, snapshot manifest, storage checksum, and access audit logs.

3) Artifacts we will provide (examples attached)
- Deletion manifest (timestamps + objects removed)
- Job execution log (server IDs, job hashes, operator id)
- Chain-of-custody template (signed)
- CAIQ pointers & SOC 2 control mappings relevant to erasure
\Action items:
- I attached bluepraxis_sig_answers_v2.pdf (example SIG answers with relevant control references).
- Also attached: segmented-erase-checklist.xlsx (internal runbook snapshot).
\Let me know if you want a short vendor-signed attestation template; Kimberly can sign off on the SOC2/controls mapping and Marissa can coordinate delivery cadence.
\Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call Monday morning if that helps.
\Best,
Logan Wright
